final.comment: The assistant had a pretty good success rate of doing what I asked. But as someone who has worked with this software for 5+ years it is just easier and quicker for me to do it myself. It is probably more beneficial to someone with less experience who doesn't know where everything is. If I was a new user using this to help me learn the software, I would like for it to go more slowly and clearly highlight what it was changing to execute my requests. I also think the nested menus of a DAW make it harder to validate that the system worked as intended (for things like adding delay to vocals that are hidden on the main screen) when compared to assistants in text editors.
